narrative.northStar: ศูนย์ประสานงาน (Coordination Centre)
narrative.overview: One visual grammar connects a numbered streetlight, its status, and the next action across residents and staff. Deep teal anchors pale green-gray working space and white records; yellow marks the outline bulb, role context, selected controls, and primary actions. Urbanist renders the separate LightFix wordmark while Thai interface copy uses IBM Plex Sans Thai.
keyCharacteristics: Pole identifiers and readable status words lead records.
The phone viewport begins the current task.
Tablet layouts use two columns; desktop staff work adds a rail.

rules.name: The Selective Yellow Rule
rules.body: Use yellow for the brand and a clear next action, rather than routine copy.

rules.name: The Identifier First Rule
rules.body: Make the pole number and status easy to find before secondary detail.

dos: Do keep the outline bulb and Urbanist wordmark separate.
Do keep status words visible alongside color.
Do begin the phone public form with pole input and symptom choices.
donts: Don't merge LightFix into bulb artwork or fill the bulb.
Don't return to a white header or large framed report form.
Don't make mobile data depend on an unlabeled wide table.
